tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Base. The sheet: page background behind everything. Achromatic in both themes. Use surface-page in components.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Base. Raised tone, one step off the sheet. Use surface-raised in components.

tokens.name: color-inset
tokens.usage: Base. Recessed tone for media frames and wells. Use surface-sunken in components.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Base. Fine decorative hairline. Use border-subtle in components.

tokens.name: color-line-2
tokens.usage: Base. Structural rule. Use border-strong in components. Decorative only (1.6–1.9:1), too faint to be a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: color-line-3
tokens.usage: Base, new in v2. A boundary that meets 3:1 on every surface in both themes (3.5:1 dark, 3.3:1 light). Use border-control in components.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Base. Highest-contrast ink: 16.4–19.4:1 on every surface in both themes. Use text-primary in components.

tokens.name: color-ink-2
tokens.usage: Base. Secondary ink: 7.4–8.7:1 on every surface. Use text-secondary in components.

tokens.name: color-ink-3
tokens.usage: Base. Meta ink: 4.9–6.0:1 on every surface. Use text-meta in components.

tokens.name: color-red
tokens.usage: Base. Swiss red, the one accent. 4.2–5.1:1 on every surface, enough for marks, rules and focus rings. Use accent in components.

tokens.name: color-red-ink
tokens.usage: Base. Red tuned to read as small text: 5.4–6.7:1 on every surface. Use text-accent in components.

tokens.name: color-on-red
tokens.usage: Base, new in v2. The only text allowed on a color-red fill: 5.0:1 dark, 4.8:1 light. Replaces color-ink on red (3.6:1).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, display type, body prose and control labels on surface-page, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary prose, descriptions, highlights, chip labels. The floor for any running sentence.

tokens.name: text-meta
tokens.usage: label-style meta only: periods, counts, nav at rest, placeholders, hints. Never a paragraph.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Red words: live status, field errors, hover text on links, outline buttons and icon keys.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse (primary button, App Store badge).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill: text selection only.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The page and every open-field section.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Logo wells, the modal close key, small chrome that sits one level up.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Media frames, the portrait well, project card grounds.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The solid key: primary button and App Store badge fill.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Default border: rows between ruled-list items, chips, icon keys, media frames.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Structural rules: section header rules, the first row of a ruled list, outline buttons.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The resting boundary of a text input (PromptField underline) and any control whose edge is its only cue.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Hover and focus borders, filled or focused input underline.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Marks: name period, header tick, highlight dashes, active nav rule, caret, scroll rule, progress steps.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Status dot for Production and In Progress. Always beside the status word.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 3px, on every focusable element. ≥4.2:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: selection-bg
tokens.usage: ::selection background.

tokens.name: selection-text
tokens.usage: ::selection text.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Modal and lightbox scrim, with a 12px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: overlay-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar ground, with a 12px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: crt-green
tokens.usage: Easter egg only: green phosphor of the CRT mode and terminal. Same in both themes (the CRT forces its own dark screen).

tokens.name: crt-amber
tokens.usage: Easter egg only: amber phosphor variant of the CRT terminal.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero name only, once per site. Fluid: fs-display-xl, floor 3.5rem.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Say the thing. I'll build it.
styles.usage: The Contact headline and any other page-level statement. Fluid: fs-display, floor 2.25rem.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: H2 section titles under a SheetHeading rule. Fluid: fs-headline, floor 1.75rem.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Project card titles. Sits under headline so a card never outranks its section. Fluid: fs-title-lg, floor 1.5rem.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: H3 role and sub-section titles. Fluid: fs-title, floor 1.25rem.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The kimrolx. wordmark; the period is always accent.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: The Contact prompt input and its confirmation. Fluid: fs-prompt, floor 1.25rem.

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: The typewriter greeting in text-secondary; 1.125rem below 640px.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: One-line project kind under a title-lg, in text-primary.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I'm a software engineer who ships full-stack systems end to end.
styles.usage: Prose in text-primary or text-secondary at a measure of 65ch.

styles.name: body-compact
styles.sample: Offline-first app tracking service intervals, history and costs per bike.
styles.usage: Dense prose: project descriptions and skill lines, in text-secondary.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Spec-list values, employment type, handles. Button labels use it at 600, -0.025em.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field hints in text-meta and field errors in text-accent.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Swiss running label, always uppercase. Spec labels, meta, nav, status, step counters. Never an eyebrow over every heading.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Inside the project rail only: counters, card labels, chips and buttons, uppercase.

styles.name: mono-link
styles.usage: A project's live URL set as its visual (DemoLink). Fluid: fs-mono-link, floor 1.25rem.

spacing.note: A 4px scale whose names match Tailwind's integer steps (space-4 = p-4 = 16px). Half steps (6, 10, 14px) are allowed only inside a component for optical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to meta, dot to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a control; chip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; heading to its description.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related blocks; spec-row column gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; SheetHeading rule to title.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between parts of an entry (title, list, chips).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Wide page gutter from 640px; above an entry's rule.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section; card side padding at desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Column gap of ruled two-column rows at desktop.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Headline to content in Contact.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Section padding at desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The only corner: buttons, chips, icon keys, inputs, frames, cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles only: status dots and slider thumbs. Never a pill-shaped control.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: The centered content column (max-w-6xl).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Prose measure (max-w-prose).

tokens.name: measure-display
tokens.usage: Max width of a display statement, so it breaks into 2–3 lines.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding below 640px.

tokens.name: gutter-wide
tokens.usage: Page side padding from 640px.

tokens.name: spec-label-col
tokens.usage: Label column of the hero SpecList.

tokens.name: row-label-col
tokens.usage: Label column of NowGroupRow and other ruled rows at desktop.

tokens.name: entry-meta-col
tokens.usage: Meta column of ExperienceEntry at desktop.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: icon keys, rail arrows, nav links, input rows.

tokens.name: size-close
tokens.usage: The modal close key.

tokens.name: size-nav
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: size-tick
tokens.usage: The red square tick on header rules.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Status dots and the portrait corner tick at rest.

tokens.name: size-dash
tokens.usage: Length of the red highlight dash and the active-nav rule.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and controls.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule, frame and control border.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Input underline, scroll rule, progress steps, caret, focus ring.

fluidType.note: Exact clamp() values for the fluid styles; the type styles hold the ceilings.

tokens.usage: display-xl, hero name.

tokens.name: fs-headline

tokens.name: fs-title-lg
tokens.usage: title-lg, project card titles.

tokens.name: fs-title

tokens.name: fs-prompt

tokens.name: fs-mono-link
tokens.usage: mono-link, DemoLink URL.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Every disabled control (buttons and rail arrows alike).

tokens.name: opacity-recede
tokens.usage: Off-center project card media. Never applied to a card's text.

tokens.name: opacity-kicker
tokens.usage: Small kicker text on surface-inverse (App Store badge "Download on the").

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover color, border and 1px lift.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Modal fade, nav rule growth, icon reveal.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Card border and focus shifts, image zoom.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals and hero stagger steps (70ms apart).

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: Default for reveals, stagger, card and frame transitions.

tokens.name: ease-out-quint
tokens.usage: CRT boot flash and achievement pop.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Content raised above section backgrounds.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar.

tokens.name: z-progress
tokens.usage: Red scroll rule, above the nav.

tokens.name: z-transition
tokens.usage: Page wipe transition.

tokens.name: z-crt-terminal
tokens.usage: CRT terminal takeover, below the scanline overlay.
